description: Hacking system configuration for Black Serenity

data-nexus.name: The Data Nexus
data-nexus.description: A sprawling underground server farm filled with humming terminals and flickering holoscreens

systems.name: Public Terminal
systems.flavor: A basic public access terminal. Easy pickings.

systems.name: Corporate Database
systems.flavor: Corporate secrets behind decent encryption. Worth the risk.

systems.name: Secure Server
systems.flavor: Military-grade encryption. Big rewards if you can crack it.

systems.name: Black ICE Node
systems.flavor: WARNING: Intrusion Countermeasures detected. Lethal.

systems.name: Ghost Server
systems.flavor: A server that doesn't exist. The kind of data that changes everything.

neon-underground.name: Neon Underground
neon-underground.description: The criminal underbelly where data brokers and hackers trade secrets

systems.name: Gang Terminal
systems.flavor: Gang communications. They won't be happy if they catch you.

systems.name: Black Market Ledger
systems.flavor: Financial records of illegal dealings. Very valuable intel.

systems.name: Syndicate Vault
systems.flavor: The Syndicate's digital vault. They kill for less.

the-forge.name: The Forge
the-forge.description: Industrial manufacturing zone with automated systems

systems.name: Factory Control
systems.flavor: Factory automation controls. Useful schematics inside.

systems.name: R&D Database
systems.flavor: Research and development secrets. Cutting edge tech.

systems.name: Prototype Archive
systems.flavor: Classified prototype designs. Worth a fortune.

ships-bridge.name: Ship's Bridge
ships-bridge.description: The nerve center of spacecraft with navigation and comm systems. Special: !hack databanks to view crew data!

systems.name: Navigation Log
systems.flavor: Ship navigation records. Trade routes and coordinates.

systems.name: Comm Array
systems.flavor: Encrypted communications. Who's talking to who?

systems.name: Captain's Terminal
systems.flavor: The captain's private terminal. Secrets and orders.

scavengers-reach.name: Scavenger's Reach
scavengers-reach.description: A planet of moving trash with buried tech. Special: !hack speeder/hoverboard/jumppack to steal vehicles!

systems.name: Derelict Console
systems.flavor: An ancient console half-buried in debris. Who knows what's on it?

systems.name: Crashed Ship Core
systems.flavor: A ship's data core. Damaged but potentially valuable.

systems.name: Military Wreck
systems.flavor: Military vessel remains. Security is still active.

systems.name: Ancient Archive
systems.flavor: Pre-war data storage. Priceless if you survive.

neural-jack-lounge.name: Neural Jack Lounge
neural-jack-lounge.description: Cipher's domain of dreams and secrets. Special: !hack cipher to uncover her hidden data... if you dare.

systems.name: Dream Server
systems.flavor: Access stored dreamscapes. Fragments of other minds.

systems.name: Customer Database
systems.flavor: Client records and preferences. Blackmail material.

terraforming-station.name: Terraforming Station
terraforming-station.description: Mara's biodomes and life support. Special: !hack plants to sabotage or !hack credits to steal funds!

systems.name: Environmental Controls
systems.flavor: Climate and atmosphere regulators. Delicate systems.

systems.name: Research Database
systems.flavor: Botanical research and genetic modifications.

none.description: The hack fails but nothing happens.

logged.message: ⚠️ Intrusion logged. Someone might come looking...

alarm.description: You triggered an alarm! Cooldown increased.
alarm.message: 🚨 ALARM TRIGGERED! Security is alerted. Lay low for a while.

trace.message: 📡 TRACE DETECTED! They're trying to find you. You need to move.

bounty.description: A bounty has been placed on you.
bounty.message: 💀 Someone noticed. Word on the street is there's credits for your head now.

damage.message: ⚡ BLACK ICE! Neural feedback burns through your system!

massive_damage.message: 💀 LETHAL ICE! Your brain feels like it's on fire!

success: You're in. Data flows like water.
ACCESS GRANTED. The system opens up to you.
Encryption crumbles. The data is yours.
Clean break. No traces left behind.
Like a ghost in the machine.
critical: PERFECT BREACH! You own this system now.
Flawless execution. They'll never know you were here.
You dance through their security like it's nothing.
The code bends to your will. Magnificent.
failure: Security protocols kick in. You're locked out.
The system fights back. You have to bail.
